messages:
Sam T: CI failed on docs PR for sdk-snippets/migration.md — linkcheck + md-lint. Error shows missing anchor for `#js-async-example` and a fenced code block flagged for trailing spaces. CI: https://ci.internal/redwood/14002
Olga M: I renamed the header to "Asynchronous JS example" earlier to be clearer. That changed the auto-generated anchor. We should either revert or add a compatibility anchor.
Ben C: Quickest path: add an explicit HTML anchor right above the header so other pages don't break. Also fix the trailing spaces in the code block. I'll make a tiny PR.
docs-bot: docs-ci-preview #14002 status: failed 0: linkcheck(1), md-lint(1) - rerun with `./ci docs-preview --pr 14002`
Sam T: Tag me on the PR pls. We need to merge before the stage cut at 15:00.
Ben C: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/445 — adds `<!-- anchor: js-async-example -->` and trims code block whitespace. Small vale-safe wording tweak too. CC @Sam T @Olga M
QA-bot: Linkcheck: previously-broken anchor now resolves. md-lint: code-block trailing-space fixed.
docs-bot: docs-ci-preview #14003 status: success 0: all checks passed. Preview: https://preview.docs.internal/redwood/sdk-snippets/migration.html
Sam T: Great, merging now. Thanks Ben.
Olga M: Note for contributors: if you rename headers, add an explicit legacy anchor or update all inbound links. Saves CI churn.
Ben C: Agreed. I'll add a one-liner to CONTRIBUTING in a follow-up.
Sam T: Merged at 15:07 UTC. Release flow unblocked.
